bio.about: Joy Villanueva is a Licensed Immigration Consultant in good standing with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC). She is also a proud member of the Canadian Association of Professional Immigration Consultants (CAPIC).
bio.experience: With years of experience in the immigration consulting industry, Joy has assisted numerous clients with applications for permanent residence, work permits, study permits, family sponsorships, and other immigration pathways. She is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to simplify complex processes, helping clients navigate Canada’s immigration system with confidence.
bio.education: Joy completed the Immigration Consultant Program with Honours at Anderson College in North York, Ontario. During her studies, she developed a strong foundation in Canadian immigration law, policies, and procedures, equipping her with the knowledge and expertise to guide clients through the immigration process effectively. Before pursuing her career in immigration, Joy earned a Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology from Far Eastern University in the Philippines.
bio.strengths: Joy brings together a deep understanding of Canadian immigration laws, strong interpersonal and communication skills, and a genuine empathy for clients from diverse backgrounds. Her organized and detail-oriented approach ensures that every application is accurate and complete, while her professionalism and integrity build lasting trust with clients. She is dedicated to delivering exceptional service marked by accuracy, transparency, and care, ensuring that each client feels supported and informed throughout their journey.
bio.background: Joy’s background in psychology enhances her ability to understand clients’ needs, offer compassionate guidance, and provide personalized immigration solutions. Her unique blend of legal and interpersonal expertise allows her to approach each case with both professionalism and empathy.
bio.commitment: With a steadfast commitment to professionalism, integrity, and client success, Joy assists individuals, families, and employers in navigating Canada’s complex immigration system with confidence and care.

bio.about: Julie Reyes is a dedicated healthcare and business professional with a strong background in nursing, client services, and immigration support. She combines compassion and professionalism to help individuals and families achieve their settlement goals in Canada.
bio.experience: Currently, Julie serves as a Client Service Coordinator at an immigration consultancy agency, where she assists clients in successfully settling in Canada. Her role involves coordinating documentation, providing support, and ensuring that each client’s journey is handled with efficiency and care.
bio.education: Julie earned her Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing in the Philippines and is a Registered Nurse. From 2009 to 2012, she pursued a Healthcare Course in the United Kingdom, gaining valuable experience and exposure to international healthcare practices. In 2019, she completed the Business Administration Program (Honours) at the Academy of Learning Career College in Toronto, expanding her expertise in business operations and client management.
bio.strengths: Known for her excellent communication skills, professionalism, and compassionate approach, Julie excels in building trust and maintaining strong client relationships. Her ability to combine empathy with strategic thinking allows her to deliver exceptional service.
bio.background: Currently, Julie serves as a Client Service Coordinator at an immigration consultancy agency, where she assists clients in successfully settling in Canada. Her role involves coordinating documentation, providing support, and ensuring that each client’s journey is handled with efficiency and care.
bio.commitment: Julie’s unique blend of healthcare expertise, business insight, and first-hand experience as a foreign worker enables her to make a meaningful impact in both client relations and community service, reflecting her deep dedication to helping others succeed.

bio.about: Irelle Villanueva is an Application Support Coordinator with 3 years of experience assisting clients and teams in navigating complex application processes with accuracy and efficiency. She is known for her attention to detail, strong communication skills, and commitment to client satisfaction.
bio.experience: In her role, Irelle assists with document preparation, issue resolution, and workflow coordination, ensuring that every application is accurate, complete, and submitted on time. She collaborates closely with teams to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and provide consistent support throughout the client journey.
bio.strengths: Irelle excels in organization, problem-solving, and client communication. She takes pride in making complex procedures smooth and stress-free, offering timely updates, and addressing client concerns with professionalism and care.
bio.background: Irelle began her professional journey in administrative and client service roles, where she developed a deep understanding of documentation, coordination, and workflow management. Her passion for helping others and ensuring smooth operations led her to specialize in application support, where she plays a key role in bridging communication between clients and teams.
bio.commitment: Dedicated to delivering a seamless and positive experience for clients, Irelle strives to ensure that every step — from submission to completion — is handled with precision, empathy, and integrity. Her passion for helping others and maintaining efficient systems makes her a valued member of any team.
